speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The stage is twice the Cross Keys. The hush held when the messenger came in black. Two thousand is a house. It is not a sum I am writing down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sam sang, and the note was clear. I am glad of the note, and I am leaving it there.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The nuts were in the yard. I am not making a picture of them.
